desc: Implement `minLength` using binary search over L with the L == 1 alternating-mismatch check and the L >= 2 run-length floor(run_len / (L + 1)) sum check.
Verified correctness: official examples pass and brute-force comparison over all binary strings length 1..9 across all numOps yields zero mismatches.
Confirmed feasibility branches are correct (L==1 alternating cost min(m1, n-m1); L>=2 run-sum floor(len/(L+1))); no mismatch found.
Dropped the priority-queue longest-run-splitting heuristic; binary-search + run arithmetic is the intended approach.
